event_description: State disaster for sea storms with coastal flooding, high winds and tidal surge in the Northwest Arctic Borough, the Bering Strait REAA and Mekoryuk.
State disaster for a February 5-11, 2006 winter storm with high winds, heavy snow, freezing rain and avalanches in Seward and Kenai Peninsula Borough communities.
Disaster declaration for flooding in the Fairbanks North Star Borough and other Interior areas.
Disaster declaration for Interior Alaska river flooding, including Eagle on the Yukon River.
State disaster for Kodiak Island after October heavy rainfall caused flooding, landslides and erosion.
State disaster for the November 2011 Bering Sea storm with high winds, storm surge, coastal flooding and ice damage along the western coast.
State disaster for severe windstorms on November 1-19, 2011 that downed power lines on the Kenai Peninsula.
Disaster declaration for heavy rainfall and river flooding, levee breaches, washouts and landslides in Talkeetna, Seward and other areas.
Disaster emergency for Yukon River flooding from late ice breakup in the Alaska Gateway, Yukon Flats, Yukon-Koyukuk and Copper River REAAs, including Galena. Dated by the report of the declaration.
State disaster for storms with powerful winds, strong seas, freezing rain and snow in the Northwest Arctic Borough, the Bering Straits REAA and the Lower Yukon.
Disaster declaration for heavy rain, high water and river erosion threatening flooding on the Matanuska River.
State disaster for a November 30 to December 2, 2020 storm with heavy rain, wind, flooding and landslides in Haines and other Southeast communities. Dated by the report of the declaration.
State disaster for the remnants of Typhoon Merbok, with hurricane-force winds, storm surge and coastal flooding along western Alaska.
State disaster for the October 2024 west coast storm with gale-force winds, heavy rain and snow, coastal surge and record rainfall.
DCI 05-212, 2005 Kaktovik Winter Storm: state disaster for a week-long severe winter storm with extremely low temperatures beginning January 7, 2005.
DCI 06-215, 2005 West Coast Storm: state disaster for a fall sea storm with tidal surges and flooding beginning September 22, 2005.
DCI 06-218, 2006 Spring Floods: state disaster for snowmelt and ice jam flooding beginning May 5, 2006.
DCI 07-219, 2006 Hooper Bay Fire: state disaster for a fire in Hooper Bay on August 3-4, 2006.
DCI 07-220, 2006 August Southcentral Flooding: state disaster for storms and flooding beginning August 18, 2006.
DCI 07-221, 2006 October Southern Alaska Storm: state disaster for storms and flooding beginning October 8, 2006.
DCI 11-233, 2011 Spring Flooding: state disaster for ice jam flooding in Red Devil and Crooked Creek beginning May 8, 2011.
DCI 13-F-243, 2013 October Kenai Peninsula Borough Flood: state disaster for heavy rain and flooding beginning October 27, 2013.
DCI AK-15-255, 2015 August North Slope Borough Sea Storm: state disaster for an arctic sea storm beginning the week of August 27, 2015.
DCI AK-15-256, 2015 December Bering Sea Storm: state disaster for a storm beginning December 12, 2015.
DCI AK-17-261, 2017 September North Slope Borough Storm: state disaster for a storm and storm surge beginning September 28, 2017.
DCI AK-17-262, 2017 December Kenai Peninsula Borough Storm: state disaster for a storm on December 4, 2017.
2022 Spring Floods: state disaster for ice jam flooding on the Tanana River at Manley Hot Springs; communities in the Copper River, Iditarod and Kuspuk REAAs added May 13, 2022.
Lowell Point landslide: state disaster for the May 7, 2022 landslide across Lowell Point Road in Seward.
2023 Spring Floods: state disaster for ice jam and snowmelt flooding on the Yukon and Kuskokwim rivers and in Glennallen.
Wrangell landslide: state disaster for the landslide in Wrangell on November 20, 2023.
2024 August Juneau Glacier Flood: state disaster for the Mendenhall Glacier outburst flood of August 6, 2024.
Ketchikan landslide: state disaster, declared verbally, for the landslide of August 25, 2024.
2025 October West Coast Storm: state disaster for the remnants of a typhoon that struck the west coast on October 8, 2025.
2025 December Mat-Su Windstorm: state disaster declaration.
DCI 02-200, 2002 Interior Floods: state disaster for flooding in interior and western communities.
DCI 03-202, Kenai Peninsula Borough Flooding: state disaster for heavy rain and flooding in the Kenai Peninsula Borough.
DCI 03-204, Southcentral Windstorm: state disaster for a windstorm in Southcentral Alaska.
